message.content:
Redesign the Dashboard page and create shared components for the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app.

## Task 1: Create shared components

Create these files in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/components/`:

### `StatCard.tsx`
A reusable metric card component used on Dashboard and Analytics pages.
```tsx
interface StatCardProps {
  title: string;
  value: string | number;
  subtitle?: string;
  trend?: { value: number; positive: boolean }; // e.g. +12% vs last period
}
```
Uses Polaris Card, BlockStack, Text, Badge. Shows the value prominently (headingXl), title as subdued bodyMd, optional trend as a small badge (tone="success" for positive, "critical" for negative).

### `EmptyStateCard.tsx`
Consistent empty state with heading, description, and CTA button.
```tsx
interface EmptyStateCardProps {
  heading: string;
  description: string;
  action: { content: string; onAction: () => void };
  secondaryAction?: { content: string; onAction: () => void };
}
```
Uses Polaris Card, EmptyState or BlockStack/Text/Button pattern.

### `PlanGate.tsx`
Banner shown when a feature requires a higher plan.
```tsx
interface PlanGateProps {
  feature: string; // e.g. "AI Recommender"
  requiredPlan: string; // e.g. "Growth"
  onUpgrade: () => void;
}
```
Uses Polaris Banner with tone="warning", shows "Upgrade to {requiredPlan} to unlock {feature}", with upgrade button.

### `BarChart.tsx`
Simple SVG bar chart for analytics.
```tsx
interface BarChartProps {
  data: Array<{ label: string; value: number }>;
  height?: number; // default 200
  barColor?: string; // default #2c6ecb (Polaris interactive)
  showLabels?: boolean; // show x-axis labels
}
```
Pure SVG component. Bars scale to max value. Shows value on hover. X-axis labels optional (rotated 45 degrees for readability). Grid lines at 25%/50%/75%/100%.

### `FunnelBar.tsx`
Horizontal funnel visualization for conversion analytics.
```tsx
interface FunnelStep {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  color?: string;
}
interface FunnelBarProps {
  steps: FunnelStep[];
}
```
Shows horizontal bars with decreasing widths, label on left, value on right. Each bar as percentage of the first (max) step.

### `index.ts`
Barrel export for all components.

## Task 2: Redesign Dashboard (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app._index.tsx`)

Read the current file first. Keep the existing loader logic but enhance it:

**Loader additions:**
- Query previous 30-day period (days 31-60) for trend comparison:
  - `previousViews` = count analytics events 31-60 days ago with eventType "view"
  - `previousRecommendations` = count analytics events 31-60 days ago with eventType "recommend"
- Calculate trend percentages in the return data

**Component redesign:**
- Use the new `StatCard` component for metrics
- Add trend data to stat cards (e.g. "+15% vs last month")
- Add a "Quick actions" row after stats: 3 cards in InlineGrid with icons/descriptions:
  1. "Create Size Chart" - "Choose from 9 templates or build custom" → /app/size-charts
  2. "Customize Widget" - "Match your store's brand" → /app/widget  
  3. "View Analytics" - "Track chart performance" → /app/analytics
- Recent charts: use a cleaner table-like layout with consistent columns (Name, Category badge, Status badge, Assignments count, Last updated)
- Keep the setup guide but make it cleaner (already good, just minor polish)
- Keep the sidebar (plan info, quick links, help)
- Remove the "Enable app" section (it's confusing) — replace with a cleaner "App Status" card showing:
  - Widget: Active/Inactive
  - Recommender: Active/Inactive
  - Charts published: X

**Important constraints:**
- Import components from `../components` (relative import)
- Use Polaris React components: Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Badge, Button, Box, Divider, InlineGrid, ProgressBar, List, Banner
- TypeScript strict — no `any`
- Keep `authenticate.admin(request)` at top of loader
- Keep all DB queries scoped by `shop`
- Use `useNavigate()` for navigation (NOT url= on Button)

Build passes cleanly. Here is a summary of every file created or changed.

---

## Files created

### `/app/components/StatCard.tsx`
Reusable metric card. Displays a prominent `headingXl` value, a subdued `bodyMd` title, an optional subtitle, and an optional trend badge (`success`/`critical` tone with percentage delta vs last month). The badge text is built as a template literal to satisfy Polaris's `Badge` children type (`string`, not `string[]`).

### `/app/components/EmptyStateCard.tsx`
Consistent empty state wrapped in a `Card`. Centres heading, description, primary action button and an optional secondary action using `BlockStack` with `inlineAlign="center"`.

### `/app/components/PlanGate.tsx`
Polaris `Banner` with `tone="warning"`. Derives its title and description from the `feature` and `requiredPlan` props. Passes the upgrade handler directly to the Banner's `action` prop — no wrapper button needed.

### `/app/components/BarChart.tsx`
Pure SVG bar chart. Key details: a `Y_AXIS_WIDTH` gutter holds auto-computed grid labels at 25/50/75/100% of max value; bars are proportional to max value; hover triggers an inline tooltip rect+text element; x-axis labels rotate 45 degrees when `showLabels` is true; all state is local (`hoveredIndex`).

### `/app/components/FunnelBar.tsx`
Horizontal funnel using CSS `div` bars inside Polaris layout primitives. Each step's bar width is `step.value / steps[0].value * 100%`. Falls back gracefully to four default colours if `step.color` is not supplied.

### `/app/components/index.ts`
Barrel export for all five components.

---

## File changed

### `/app/routes/app._index.tsx`

**Loader additions:**
- `sixtyDaysAgo` computed alongside `thirtyDaysAgo`
- Two new parallel queries: `previousViews` (days 31–60 view events) and `previousRecommendations` (days 31–60 recommend events)
- `totalRecommendations` now counts the current 30-day window (consistent with views)
- `calcTrend()` helper computes `{ value, positive }` for both metrics; returned as `viewsTrend` and `recommendationsTrend`

**Component changes:**
- Stats row uses `StatCard` from `../components` with trend data passed through
- "Enable app" section replaced with an "App status" card: three `StatusRow` sub-components showing Widget (active/inactive), AI Recommender (active/inactive, with a `Growth+` badge when the plan doesn't include it), and Charts published count
- New "Quick actions" row: three `QuickActionCard` sub-components in a 3-column `InlineGrid` pointing to `/app/size-charts`, `/app/widget`, and `/app/analytics`
- Recent charts section now renders a structured table using `InlineGrid columns="1fr 120px 120px 90px 110px"` with a column-header row and a `Divider` before the data rows — consistent columns: Name, Category badge, Status badge, Assigned, Updated
- All `useNavigate()` usage preserved; no `url=` on `Button`; zero `any` types
